title: Manteen registry author conformance profile
description: Author-only evidence ownership for claims in a Manteen registry catalog. This data is validated during author builds and is never compiled into registry wire output.

scripts.description: Ordered root package.json scripts run by manteen-kit build and dev before publishing registry output.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock ceiling applied independently to each author verification script.

stylesApi.description: Explicit evidence ownership for item/component claims in the catalog's stylesApi declarations.

evidence.description: Canonical repository-relative POSIX path to one existing ordinary evidence file.

props.description: Explicit evidence ownership for item/export claims in the catalog's props declarations.
